newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market thin at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market thin at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test. Inquiry good, demand moderate.
Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter steers and 100 slaughter heifers Monday. For the week to date including late Friday and the weekend sales confirmed on 15000 cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1375 lbs 72.00, load 71.00. Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs 71.00.
